messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Beta-blockers affect the heart and circulation (blood flow through arteries and veins).
Carvedilol is used to treat heart failure and hypertension (high blood pressure).
Carvedilol is also used after a heart attack that has caused your heart not to pump as well.
Carvedilol may also be used for purposes not listed in this medication guide.
Carvedilol is not approved for use by anyone younger than 18 years of age.
Triplet: ["Carvedilol", "used in", "post-heart attack with reduced pumping"]

The relation 'used in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is employed in the specific clinical scenario or condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'may be prescribed with': The subject drug may be prescribed in combination with the medication specified by the object entity.
